proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D
  have key : ∀ X Y Z : P, midpoint ℝ Y Z -ᵥ midpoint ℝ X Y = (2⁻¹ : ℝ) • (Z -ᵥ X) := by
    intro X Y Z
    rw [midpoint_vsub_midpoint, midpoint_eq_smul_add, add_comm, vsub_add_vsub_cancel, invOf_eq_inv]
  have hd : ∀ X Y Z : P, dist (midpoint ℝ X Y) (midpoint ℝ Y Z) = dist X Z / 2 := by
    intro X Y Z
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V, key, norm_smul, dist_comm X Z, dist_eq_norm_vsub V Z X]
    norm_num
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, hd A B C, hd B C D⟩
  rw [key A B C, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev (midpoint ℝ D A) (midpoint ℝ C D), key C D A, ← smul_neg, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), midpoint ℝ B C -ᵥ midpoint ℝ A B = midpoint ℝ C D -ᵥ midpoint ℝ D A ∧ dist (midpoint ℝ A B) (midpoint ℝ B C) = dist A C / 2 ∧ dist (midpoint ℝ B C) (midpoint ℝ C D) = dist B D / 2
